goal: Set how many days before a subscription payment method expires health reads flag it as method_expiring (method expiry warning window, card expiration threshold, expiring card alert).
whyThisDefault: Thirty days preserves the historical method expiry warning window in subscription_method_health_read while giving subscribers one monthly billing cycle to update an expiring payment method.

effect.appliesTo: Subsequent calls to subscription_method_health_read evaluate active payment method expires_at <= now() + make_interval(days => payment_method_expiry_warning_days_read()) and classify matching expiring methods as method_expiring. When no row exists in public.commerce_settings, the SQL reader defaults to 30 days; malformed rows refuse fail-closed with SQLSTATE 22023 payment_method_expiry_warning_days_policy_invalid.
frozenOn: Already recorded renewal attempts, retry obligations, dunning notifications, and billing cycles retain their recorded state.

runtime.reason: Install or update the public.commerce_settings row through installPaymentMethodExpiryWarningDaysPolicy or your store deployment step; runtime edits require a write-capable host connection.

rules.description: Supply exactly revision and warningDays. Revision must be a nonblank string and warningDays an integer from 1 through 365.
